qualification.details: Rural Finance Specialist, PIU: Graduate degree, preferably post-graduate degree in rural finance, economics, business administration, development studies, or related field with Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, including 5 years in planning and implementing microfinance, agribusiness or rural development projects. Livelihood Coordinator, CPIU: Masters/Post-graduate degree in Livelihoods, Entrepreneurship Development, Food Security, Agriculture, Agribusiness, value chain Development, Rural Development, Social sciences or related field with Minimum 5 years of professional experience in promoting livelihoods interventions. Hydrology Specialist, PIU: Postgraduate degree in Hydrology or Water Resources or Soil & Water Conservation Engineering or Irrigation Engineering or Geology or Earth Science or Environmental Science or related field with Minimum 5 years of professional experience in hydrological studies and water resources assessment. GIS and MIS Executive, CPIU: Master's degree in GIS, Geography, Environmental Sciences, IT, Computer Science or related fields with Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in GIS & MIS systems. Financial Management Specialist, PIU: Masters in Commerce/ MBA Finance or related field with At least 7 years' relevant experience in financial management, accounting, auditing. Junior Engineer (Civil), CPIU: Diploma in Civil Engineering/ Civil Engineering and Planning / Construction Technology recognized by AICTE with Minimum 5 years of working experience in Planning/ Execution/ Maintenance of Civil Engineering works. Accountant, CPIU: Graduate/ Postgraduate in Commerce with Minimum 7 years of working experience in project/program financial accounting.

faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in date for ARIAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The interviews are held on seven dates, one per post: 01.12.2026 (Rural Finance Specialist), 03.12.2026 (Livelihood Coordinator), 05.12.2026 (Hydrology Specialist), 07.12.2026 (GIS and MIS Executive), 09.12.2026 (Financial Management Specialist), 11.12.2026 (Junior Engineer (Civil)) and 15.12.2026 (Accountant).

faq.question: Q2. Where will the ARIAS walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The interviews are at the office of the State Project Director, ARIASS, Agriculture Campus, Six-mile, Guwahati-781022.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in ARIAS SWIFT recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 18 positions in total: 1 Rural Finance Specialist, 4 Livelihood Coordinator, 1 Hydrology Specialist, 4 GIS and MIS Executive, 1 Financial Management Specialist, 5 Junior Engineer (Civil) and 2 Accountant.

faq.question: Q4. Are these ARIAS posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the positions are to be filled on a purely contractual basis for the SWIFT Project.

faq.question: Q5. Which project are the ARIAS posts for?
faq.answer: The posts are for the Assam Sustainable Wetland and Integrated Fisheries Transformation (SWIFT) Project, with financial and technical support from the Asian Development Bank (ADB).

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the Terms of Reference for the ARIAS posts?
faq.answer: The notice advises candidates to visit https://www.arias.in/ for further details of the advertisement and the relevant Terms of Reference (ToR).

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview for Junior Engineer (Civil) in ARIAS?
faq.answer: The interview for the 5 Junior Engineer (Civil), CPIU positions is on 11.12.2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview for Accountant in ARIAS?
faq.answer: The interview for the 2 Accountant, CPIU positions is on 15.12.2026.
